notes: SHIP v1.14.432 - FOLD AND REVERT. THE FIRST-RUN GATE ALREADY EXISTED, AND .431 BUILT A SECOND ONE. WHAT WENT WRONG. Asked for the boot gate, I searched for the SPEC NAME - siteSetup, SITE SETUP, rd_openSiteSetup - found nothing, and concluded the destination did not exist. It existed and always had. launch() has ended with a first-run gate since v1.6.70: if the profile is not confirmed it calls firstRun_show, a redesign-gated setup surface built against an APPROVED mock, new-device-setup-v2.html at v1.14.200, with a legacy fallback and a v1.14.346 upgrade that pre-fills from the loaded Master. The feature is named firstRun_star, not siteSetup_star. I searched for a label instead of a concept, and I did not read what already runs at first boot before building a replacement for it. .431 was therefore a SECOND DOOR onto an existing concept - a Contract A2 violation - and it shipped. THE RULE THAT CATCHES THIS NEXT TIME: before building any flow, read the function that runs at the moment the flow would start. launch() named the answer in one line. WHAT WAS GENUINELY MISSING, measured rather than assumed, and now folded into the canonical door. FIRST, SITE LEAD: the gate predates the .417 and .418 identity split and collected an operator only, so AUTHORITY had no first-run home and every new device started with siteLead empty. It now has a Site Lead field that DEFAULTS to the operator name - a value written once and then editable, never a read-time coalesce, because .418 removed exactly that fallback for silently granting lead-only RBAC to an empty actor. SECOND, THE MASTER STEP: the gate could pre-fill FROM a Master but never LOAD one, so a genuinely new device had to confirm, land on Home and go find the importer. It now offers LOAD MASTER FILE, which calls master_loadFromPicker - the ONE door, which already parses, stages, validates, shows counts and activates on a tap. Section 4.2 forbids a second write path to Master state and this adds none: the gate reports what is loaded and writes no Master state itself. After a load it offers the site code the Master knows for any identity field still empty - editable, never forced. RULE 17 HELD THROUGHOUT. Only the redesign branch of firstRun_show changed; the legacy branch is byte-identical. firstRun_confirm is SHARED by both branches, so the Site Lead write is guarded on the ELEMENT EXISTING rather than on the house - a bare read would throw under legacy and a default would change legacy behaviour. Absent element means that block does nothing. Pinned by test in the legacy house. WHAT WAS REVERTED. The whole .431 flow: its sheet markup, its CSS, its JavaScript, and its menu door. Also its setupInProgress backfill exception - that guard existed because .431 saved identity MID-FLOW, which made siteProfile_load treat an abandoned setup as confirmed. firstRun_confirm writes ONCE, at the end, with confirmedAt in the same save, so the hazard is gone and a guard whose hazard no longer exists is a guard that misleads. The v1.6.70 backfill is restored exactly and pinned, because breaking it re-prompts every device in the field. THE BOOT GATE ITSELF NEEDED NO NEW CODE. It has been wired into launch() for a very long time; what it lacked was a destination worth arriving at. TESTS: spec 21 replaced - 21-site-setup deleted, 21-first-run-gate added, nine tests. The gate is wired into boot, Site Lead defaults to the operator, Site Lead is independent of the operator, the Master step exists and uses the one door, the Master line is honest with nothing loaded and accurate with something loaded, the legacy branch has no Site Lead field and still confirms, the v1.6.70 backfill is unchanged, and the reverted flow left nothing behind. 21 plus 10 plus 11 plus 14 plus 01: 59 passed. GATES: 3 inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, CSS braces 4599/4599, CRLF intact, three-stamp lockstep. DEVICE-VERIFY: worth one look on a device you can afford to re-set-up, since this is the surface a NEW device meets. Expect YOUR NAME, SITE, SITE LEAD, MASTER FILE and the optional floor details, with CONFIRM AND ENTER at the bottom.
